sql: WITH remuneracao_2024 AS (SELECT r.dsc_cargo, AVG(CAST(r.vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS media_remuneracao FROM remuneracao_municipio r JOIN pessoa_municipio p ON r.seq_dim_pessoa = p.seq_dim_pessoa WHERE r.ano_referencia = 2024 AND r.dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%' AND COALESCE(p.nom_pessoa, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' GROUP BY r.dsc_cargo) SELECT dsc_cargo, media_remuneracao FROM remuneracao_2024 ORDER BY media_remuneracao DESC LIMIT 5;
